instruction: Look at seed_ss_gui_20_combo_profile.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Combine the three existing rectangles into a single profile: a 160 x 30 base plate, a 40 x 25 upper-left boss, and a 50 x 40 upper-right boss. The bosses share edges with the base plate. Add two diameter 10 holes on the base at (40,15) and (120,15). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_20.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
